metadata.description: Strong Force Analytics internal Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: architect-crew
plugins.description: Opus architect delegates bounded work to Haiku/Sonnet subagents (scout, runner, builder).

plugins.name: okf
plugins.description: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) doc headers, by scaccogatto: write, validate, visualize and serve OKF bundles. The team's pick for doc headers; /sfa:card-submit and /sfa:card-close use its format check.

plugins.name: queue
plugins.description: Session lanes by Brett Ragozzine: one QUEUE.md per repo, /queue:spec, /queue:build, /queue:audit and /queue:meta to open a session, /queue:end to hand off and open the pull request, /queue:init to set a repo up.

plugins.name: sfa
plugins.description: Team kit: answers how SFA works from the team handbook, Trello through the official Trello MCP server plus a small helper, the card gates /sfa:card-new, /sfa:card-start, /sfa:card-submit and /sfa:card-close, the team commands /sfa:setup, /sfa:ask, /sfa:onboard and /sfa:daily-update, and the role report /sfa:ceo.
